items.title: Build, Deploy, and Govern Your Agents with MongoDB Atlas Agent Engine
items.summary: Big Model vs. Big Harness has been an ongoing debate in AI engineering. An agent harness is everything besides the LLM that makes an agent work, including the runtime, tools, context, and guardrails surrounding the model. As models improve, the parts of the harness that coax better reasoning out of the model, such as prompts and loops, will likely get absorbed into the model, while the control layers won't.
